findings.note: A Browse Genres screen exists, but the FSD describes only People and Tags under Browse.
An All Annotations screen exists under Browse, but the FSD does not describe it.

findings.fsdQuote: The People screen lists people with the number of series and issues each appears in, along with a filter panel and a jump bar, and clicking a person opens that person's page.
findings.note: A People browse route renders BrowsePeopleComponent. This match is based on the route only. I did not read the component for the counts, filter panel or jump bar.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The server requires a minimum password length of 6, not 8.

findings.fsdQuote: Days of Backups and Days of Logs each accept a value from 1 to 30 and both default to 30.
findings.note: The server rejects Days of Backups and Days of Logs values above 30 or below 1. I did not read the default of 30, so only the range is confirmed.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: The new-library form defaults manageCollections to false.

findings.fsdQuote: Include in Dashboard and Include in Search are turned on by default.
findings.note: Both includeInDashboard and includeInSearch default to true.
